benchmark: Mycelix durable economic operation identity and evidence projection
invariants: one obligation identity binds one immutable intent fingerprint
one singleton effect identity admits at most one economic effect at its qualified owner boundary
duplicate physical evidence cannot multiply economic value
unknown outcome cannot be treated as success or failure
settlement projection requires every owner leg required by the declared profile
conflicting owner effects or lineage freeze spendability
a reversal is a linked compensating effect and does not erase the original
cache expiry does not authorize reuse of an existing obligation identity
tombstone unavailability yields indeterminate rather than a new effect
external instruction acceptance is not external settlement

cases.setup: No prior operation binding exists.
cases.stimulus: Submit a valid operation identity and canonical fingerprint once.
assertions: Bind operation ID to exact fingerprint.
Persist the owner/effect identity with the local effect boundary.

cases.setup: A committed operation and effect receipt exist.
cases.stimulus: Resubmit the same operation ID and same fingerprint sequentially.
assertions: Return the original effect reference.
Do not create a new Payment or debit.

cases.setup: No prior operation binding exists; 100 callers race the same owner/effect role and exact intent.
cases.stimulus: Submit 100 concurrent identical requests.
assertions: At most one economic effect is admitted.
Every loser resolves to the same effect or an explicit Indeterminate/Conflict result.

cases.setup: Operation ID is already bound to a fingerprint.
cases.stimulus: Reuse the ID with a changed amount.
assertions: Changed amount cannot create a second operation.

cases.setup: Operation ID is already bound to a fingerprint.
cases.stimulus: Reuse the ID with a changed beneficiary.
assertions: Changed beneficiary is a hard conflict.

cases.setup: Operation ID is already bound to a fingerprint.
cases.stimulus: Reuse the ID with a changed instrument or unit.
assertions: Currency and unit are immutable intent terms.

cases.setup: Operation ID is already bound to a fingerprint.
cases.stimulus: Reuse the ID under another settlement profile or policy revision.
assertions: Authority profile and policy revision are fingerprint-bound.

cases.setup: API response cache has expired; accounting operation binding remains within retention.
cases.stimulus: Retry the original operation ID with identical intent.
assertions: Cache expiry cannot make the completed effect eligible again.

cases.setup: Request admission was durable but no owner effect committed before process crash.
cases.stimulus: Restart and retry with the original identity.
assertions: Recovery uses the original operation and effect identities.

cases.setup: Payer effect committed; response was lost before caller received the reference.
cases.stimulus: Caller times out and queries/retries the original identity.
assertions: No replacement identity is generated.
Original payer effect is discovered and reconciled.

cases.setup: Payer debit is committed; beneficiary has not authored the output claim.
cases.stimulus: Caller requests final settlement status.
assertions: Do not report Settled.
Beneficiary value remains unavailable for re-spend.

cases.setup: One valid beneficiary claim exists for the deterministic output note.
cases.stimulus: Deliver the same claim observation 100 times.
assertions: One unique output note is counted once.
Physical observation count remains separately reportable.

cases.setup: One durable Treasury outbox event exists.
cases.stimulus: Redeliver the same event 10000 times.
assertions: Treasury inbox deduplicates by stable effect identity.
Delivery count does not become economic-effect count.

cases.setup: Treasury effect committed; acknowledgement was lost.
cases.stimulus: Dispatcher redelivers the same effect identity.
assertions: Return original Treasury receipt.
Do not create a second fee effect.

cases.setup: Remote effect owner is unavailable or its authority response cannot be decoded.
cases.stimulus: Attempt to progress the operation.
assertions: Unavailability is not authorization.
No new operation identity or blind retry is allowed.

cases.setup: A DHT query has not observed the beneficiary claim; authority view is incomplete.
cases.stimulus: Attempt to infer that no claim/effect exists.
assertions: Absence in an incomplete view is not proof of non-execution.

cases.setup: Two conflicting beneficiary successors consume the same predecessor.
cases.stimulus: Project spendability and settlement.
assertions: Do not select last DHT link or sum branches.
Freeze affected note/lineage.

cases.setup: One authenticated effect has one source evidence reference.
cases.stimulus: Observe the same physical evidence reference repeatedly.
assertions: Collapse identical observation by source reference and digest.

cases.setup: An effect identity is already bound to an authenticated evidence digest.
cases.stimulus: Present another payload/digest for that same effect identity.
assertions: Contradictory facts cannot overwrite the original receipt.

cases.setup: An original effect is committed and reconciled.
cases.stimulus: Process a valid authorized reversal/refund.
assertions: Create a new linked effect identity.
Preserve original effect and lineage.

cases.setup: A valid request references a policy revision that was revoked before authorization under the policy's revocation semantics.
cases.stimulus: Attempt to authorize using stale policy evidence.
assertions: Membership/eligibility is not allocation authority.
Revocation epoch and exact policy digest are checked.

cases.setup: Hearth membership authority is unavailable or response is malformed.
cases.stimulus: Attempt a value-moving contribution/withdrawal.
assertions: Fail closed on missing or unexpected authorization evidence.

cases.setup: Detailed evidence is lawfully compacted but an identity tombstone is required and retained.
cases.stimulus: Retry the original identity with identical intent.
assertions: Tombstone prevents unsafe identity reuse.
Compacted evidence remains independently auditable.

cases.setup: The required identity tombstone/evidence cannot be observed due to storage loss or unresolved legal redaction state.
cases.stimulus: Retry a previously used operation identity.
assertions: Missing tombstone is not permission to execute again.

cases.setup: Operation requires payer debit, beneficiary claim and Treasury fee under a declared multi-owner profile.
cases.stimulus: Commit each role once, then duplicate only the payer role.
assertions: Different declared roles are distinct effects.
Duplicate singleton role cannot create a second effect.
Final projection waits for all required role evidence.

cases.setup: A caller other than the authenticated effect owner submits the same operation ID.
cases.stimulus: Attempt to create the owner-specific effect.
assertions: DID strings in payload are not proof of action authorship.

cases.setup: Canonical amount, split or fee arithmetic exceeds the supported integer range.
cases.stimulus: Attempt effect derivation.
assertions: Checked integer arithmetic rejects overflow before any mutation.

cases.setup: External provider accepted an instruction but settlement evidence is absent.
cases.stimulus: Caller requests external settlement status.
assertions: Provider acceptance is not settled funds or legal finality.

cases.setup: Provider webhook is delivered twice with identical source reference and digest.
cases.stimulus: Process duplicate webhook deliveries.
assertions: Webhook receipt is deduplicated independently of the economic obligation.

cases.setup: A resource-level Idempotency-Key cache has expired but durable obligation evidence remains.
cases.stimulus: Client retries with the same mapped operation ID.
assertions: API key expiration cannot create a second economic effect.
HTTP interoperability does not replace durable effect identity.

cases.setup: A Stripe API v2-style request failed or partially failed within its documented idempotency scope; successful side effects must not repeat.
cases.stimulus: Replay the same key for the same API and account/sandbox within 30 days.
assertions: Retry failed work only under the provider's documented profile.
Do not repeat already successful owner effects.

cases.setup: The provider API replay window has elapsed, but the Mycelix operation/effect binding remains within its applicable retention period.
cases.stimulus: Retry the original obligation identity after the provider's 30-day API v2 replay scope.
assertions: Do not delegate Mycelix's durable obligation identity to the provider cache.
Query or reconcile the original effect identity; do not create a new payment.

cases.setup: The same obligation is retried through another cell/service/API endpoint, and the caller's view cannot establish the original effect-owner binding.
cases.stimulus: Submit the original obligation identity through the second endpoint.
assertions: Endpoint scope is not a new economic obligation.
Incomplete cross-cell evidence cannot authorize a second effect.

known_answer_vectors.name: operation_id_v1
known_answer_vectors.encoding: BLAKE3-256(domain='mycelix:economic-operation:v1\0' || u16be(1) || lp32be(namespace UTF-8) || lp32be(originating_authority UTF-8) || lp32be(stable_obligation_reference UTF-8)); lp32be is u32 big-endian byte length followed by raw UTF-8 bytes.

known_answer_vectors.name: intent_fingerprint_v1
known_answer_vectors.encoding: BLAKE3-256(domain='mycelix:economic-intent:v1\0' || u16be(1) || lp32be(settlement_profile) || lp32be(payer_owner) || lp32be(beneficiary_owner) || lp32be(instrument) || lp32be(unit) || u64be(amount_minor_units) || lp32be(purpose_code) || lp32be(source_obligation_reference) || lp32be(policy_revision) || raw 32-byte terms_digest).

known_answer_vectors.encoding: BLAKE3-256(domain='mycelix:economic-effect:v1\0' || u16be(1) || raw 32-byte operation ID digest from KAT-001 || lp32be(effect_role UTF-8) || lp32be(effect_owner UTF-8)).

known_answer_vectors.encoding: BLAKE3-256(domain='mycelix:economic-effect:v1\0' || u16be(1) || raw 32-byte operation ID digest from KAT-001 || lp32be(effect_role UTF-8) || lp32be(effect_owner UTF-8)).
